# react-web design fixture

A small React 18 + Tailwind app used by the design stage's live checks. It has a component package (`components/`: Button, Card, Chip) and three routes: `/`, `/trips`, `/settings`. `design.md` is a filled example.

Install and start:

```
npm install
npm run web
```

Then open http://localhost:3110 (stop with Ctrl-C). It holds no credentials.
